stemMd: If the hall is open, the alarm is off. The alarm is on. What follows?
explanationMd: An open hall would require the alarm to be off. Since it is on, the antecedent cannot hold. This is the contrapositive inference; it says nothing about occupancy or tomorrow.

distractorRationale.c: This contradicts the conditional and observed alarm.
